sn35.145:1.15: catuttho devadaho → cuddasamo tatruddānaṁ devadaha (bj) | catuttho → cuddasamo (cck)
sn35.145:2.1: rūpā → satayha gayha (bj) | devadaho khaṇo rūpā → devadahakhaṇopaggayha aggayha (sya-all) | khaṇo → devadaho khaṇe (bj: machasaṁ) | gayha → paggayha, aggayha (bj: syā)
sn35.145:2.2: natumhākameva ca → honti palāsīnā (bj); honti manasinā (sya-all) | palāsīnā → deva na tumhākameva ca (bj: machasaṁ)
sn35.145:2.4: duve ajjhattabāhirāti → te kho ajjhatta bāhirāti (bj) | bāhirāti → duve ajjhattabāhirā (bj: machasaṁ, syā)
